title: Rosemary Beach "The Salty Rose" 49 Hamilton Lane
h1: Rosemary Beach "The Salty Rose" 49 Hamilton Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- This home has been designed by and is owned by Kate from Kate Marker Interiors- Located Near Town Center- 2 vehicle parking- Private Saltwater Pool- Private Beach- 4 Neighborhood Pools- 4 Adult Bikes- Adjacent to Timpoochee Trail- Carriage house- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: The Salty Rose is a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Rosemary Beach Main House and Carriage House that sleeps 12. Guests will love the private splash pool with a fire feature, outdoor kitchen, posh finishes, and tranquil interiors. The Salty Rose is close to restaurants, shops, -community pools, and the beach.An elevated front porch welcomes guests to the home and is a beautiful place to relax and greet neighbors headed to the beach. Stepping inside, guests will find a living, dining, and kitchen area decorated in subdued shades of dusty rose and beige. Hardwood floors, exposed ceiling beams, and natural light add to the inviting atmosphere. A sofa and armchairs surround a gas fireplace and a 50” Smart TV in the living area and are divided from a galley-style kitchen by a round dining table. A bi-fold wall in the kitchen opens completely to a private courtyard, expanding the space and bringing the outdoors in. Guests can prepare meals using a Wolf 6-burner gas range and premium appliances in the kitchen, or fire up the gas grill in the courtyard’s outdoor kitchen. Guests can dine poolside beneath the stars, recline on a lounge chair, and watch the flames dance on the pool’s fire feature.Guests can grab a cocktail on the way up to the second floor, thanks to a wine cooler and beverage station tucked into the stair landing. The second floor includes a guest bedroom with a loft space, the primary bedroom, and access to the adjacent Carriage House. The spacious guest bedroom uses a shared hall bathroom and features a lovely 4-poster king bed, a gas fireplace, and a 50” Smart TV. Stairs lead to a loft area with 2 twin beds. The primary bedroomhas a unique private bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower with 2 rainfall shower heads and a large skylight. The relaxing all-white bedroom has a king bed and opens to a porch that connects to the Carriage House.The Salty Rose’s Carriage House feels like a full-size home thanks to its spacious living room, full kitchen, and sophisticated interiors. Guests may access the Carriage House from a connected porch or an exterior spiral staircase. The 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Carriage House sleeps 6 and reflects the subdued color palette of the Main House. A high vaulted ceiling adds space to the open kitchen and living area. A Subzero refrigerator, Wolf 4-burner gas range, afarmhouse sink, marble countertops, and a dine-in island provide everything needed to prepare a delicious meal. Guests can curl up before a gas fireplace or enjoy a movie on the 50” Smart TV before retiring to the primary bedroom. The sophisticated bedroom has a queen bed, a 50” Smart TV, and a shared bathroom.A white spiral staircase leads to a loft with 2 full beds and a private bathroom.The Salty Rose will book quickly. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12)SECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed and 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: 2 Full Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Rosemary Beach "The Salty Rose" 49 Hamilton Lane Rosemary Beach, FL Bedrooms 4 Beds 6 Sleeps 12 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - This home has been designed by and is owned by Kate from Kate Marker Interiors - Located Near Town Center - 2 vehicle parking - Private Saltwater Pool - Private Beach - 4 Neighborhood Pools - 4 Adult Bikes - Adjacent to Timpoochee Trail - Carriage house - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: The Salty Rose is a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Rosemary Beach Main House and Carriage House that sleeps 12. Guests will love the private splash pool with a fire feature, outdoor kitchen, posh finishes, and tranquil interiors. The Salty Rose is close to restaurants, shops, -community pools, and the beach. An elevated front porch welcomes guests to the home and is a beautiful place to relax and greet neighbors headed to the beach. Stepping inside, guests will find a living, dining, and kitchen area decorated in subdued shades of dusty rose and beige. Hardwood floors, exposed ceiling beams, and natural light add to the inviting atmosphere. A sofa and armchairs surround a gas fireplace and a 50” Smart TV in the living area and are divided from a galley-style kitchen by a round dining table. A bi-fold wall in the kitchen opens completely to a private courtyard, expanding the space and bringing the outdoors in. Guests can prepare meals using a Wolf 6-burner gas range and premium appliances in the kitchen, or fire up the gas grill in the courtyard’s outdoor kitchen. Guests can dine poolside beneath the stars, recline on a lounge chair, and watch the flames dance on the pool’s fire feature. Guests can grab a cocktail on the way up to the second floor, thanks to a wine cooler and beverage station tucked into the stair landing. The second floor includes a guest bedroom with a loft space, the primary bedroom, and access to the adjacent Carriage House. The spacious guest bedroom uses a shared hall bathroom and features a lovely 4-poster king bed, a gas fireplace, and a 50” Smart TV. Stairs lead to a loft area with 2 twin beds. The primary bedroom has a unique private bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower with 2 rainfall shower heads and a large skylight. The relaxing all-white bedroom has a king bed and opens to a porch that connects to the Carriage House. The Salty Rose’s Carriage House feels like a full-size home thanks to its spacious living room, full kitchen, and sophisticated interiors. Guests may access the Carriage House from a connected porch or an exterior spiral staircase. The 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Carriage House sleeps 6 and reflects the subdued color palette of the Main House. A high vaulted ceiling adds space to the open kitchen and living area. A Subzero refrigerator, Wolf 4-burner gas range, a farmhouse sink, marble countertops, and a dine-in island provide everything needed to prepare a delicious meal. Guests can curl up before a gas fireplace or enjoy a movie on the 50” Smart TV before retiring to the primary bedroom. The sophisticated bedroom has a queen bed, a 50” Smart TV, and a shared bathroom. A white spiral staircase leads to a loft with 2 full beds and a private bathroom. The Salty Rose will book quickly. Book today!
